requests.prompt: Edit this specific Seedlands CLASSIC approval board. User requests ONLY a somewhat more modern, refined TEXTURE treatment and moderately lower saturation. Preserve classic Minecraft-like geometry, exact object silhouettes, proportions, camera, scene layout, UI, lighting design, and crisp coarse pixel scale. Do not modernize models or gameplay. Repaint surface texture colors and pixel-cluster organization only. Grass/leaves become natural medium grass/olive greens instead of neon lime. Wood becomes soft natural oak/brown with less yellow/orange; dirt is balanced earthy brown. Stone neutral gray with restrained coherent clusters and less salt-and-pepper noise. Keep textures clearly legible and colorful, NOT globally gray, washed out, sepia, pastel, blurry, or dark. Colored accents stay distinctive. Preserve sharp native pixel edges, simple 16px visual language. No PBR, no bevels, no smoothing, no new lights, no bloom, no cinematic color grade. Preserve the flat gray sheet background, all labels and layout. Keep all sixteen wool colors visibly distinct, reducing only excessive saturation, especially lime/orange/magenta. Red flower becomes natural poppy red; yellow flower warm yellow rather than fluorescent. Keep the full sheet and all items; do not crop. The refinement should be visibly noticeable in material palettes and pixel structure, not just a uniform desaturation filter.
